selection: All catalog entries within 84arcsec of the target (about four TESS pixels), independent of invalid raw-map centroids. No single-variable attribution.
policy: TIC Gaia identifiers treated as DR2; obtain DR2-to-DR3 neighborhood mappings before querying DR3. Retain all mappings, errors and nonmatches. Catalog labels do not uniquely identify the TESS source or exclude unlisted variability.
